method.arms: Current black fill. Edge uses the nearest actual border pixel outside the source. Supported keeps each current component with at least half its grid pixels also retained in the edge pass. All views use the same source crop, thresholds, selection caps and reliability grid.
method.background: Take eight distinct qualified LaMa groups in byte-hash order, disjoint from the two prior padding/small-region and progressive-earlier-copy panels. Keep the exact AI edit and matched original, local tone and local blur as native 768-side JPEG75 deliveries.
method.native: Keep all 59 previously measured native images and their four roles (48 source groups). Verify the exact archived current responses, delivered PNG bytes, and changed-pixel truth.
method.recoded: Take the first 20 distinct source groups in frozen confirmation order with a short side at least two thirds of the long side. Encode the AI edit and its original as upright 768-pixel-long-side JPEG75. Use the exact post-resize, pre-encode changed pixels.
method.useful: At least 0.30 intersection over union and 0.50 recall on exact pre-encode changed pixels. Count useful losses, gains, misplaced flags and ordinary flags separately by cohort and geometry.
